about: [O2] after the critic (B1): a fare lost on the way - in the taxi, the fare in, the minimap's ring and the lantern show the drop-off, and I drive the other way on and on: 'Wrong way.', 'Come on.', then he gets out ('He got out.'): a lost fare ends. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o2_fare_lost.json
